alt: Artist's rendering of the Rocket Lab Neutron heavy-lift rocket in its stacked two-stage configuration
story: Rocket Lab announced on October 15, 2026 that its Neutron rocket's maiden launch is pushed to 2027 after engineers found microscopic voids (air pockets) in the carbon-composite forward dome of the first-stage propellant tank — a manufacturing flaw that knocked 11% off the company's stock.
why_funny: Years of development and hundreds of millions of dollars, and the showstopper is: there's air where there shouldn't be air.
